# Lloyd Institute of Forensic Science

> Lloyd Institute of Forensic Science is a premier forensic education institution in Delhi NCR offering specialized undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs in forensic science disciplines.

The institute provides comprehensive forensic science education through integrated degree programs, specialized postgraduate diplomas, and hands-on training with industry partnerships including Delhi Police and CFSL. Students gain expertise in fingerprint analysis, document examination, multimedia forensics, toxicology, and crime scene investigation through both classroom instruction and practical field exposure.

## Key Topics

- Forensic Science

## Flagship Programs

- [B.Sc + M.Sc Forensic Science (5-Year Integrated) Program: Overview & Benefits](https://lifs.co.in/courses/bsc-msc-forensic-science-5-year-integrated.html): 5-year integrated B.Sc + M.Sc forensic science program with DNA and digital forensics specialization
- [M.Sc Forensic Science Course, Eligibility, Duration](http://lifs.co.in/courses/m-sc-forensic-science.html): M.Sc Forensic Science postgraduate degree with fingerprint and ballistics specialization
- [M.Sc in Multimedia Forensics – Lloyd Institute of Forensic Science](https://lifs.co.in/courses/m-sc-multimedia-forensic.html): M.Sc Multimedia Forensics master's degree with video and image analysis

## Postgraduate Diplomas

- [PG Diploma in Fingerprint Science at Lloyd College: Course Details & Benefits](http://lifs.co.in/courses/pg-diploma-in-fingerprint-science.html): PG Diploma in fingerprint science with biometrics and AFIS training
- [PG Diploma in Forensic Document Examination: Course Overview & Career Path](http://lifs.co.in/courses/pg-diploma-in-forensic-document-examination.html): PG Diploma in forensic document examination and questioned documents analysis
